messages:
Anya K: Quick check — we need to finalize owners and due dates for the RCA action items from Fri's outage. I put a draft in the doc: https://redwood.team/r/rca-2026-03. Can folks confirm or update?
Matt B: saw it. I can take the task for the autoscaler change but need eng-infra input on the rollout window. propose due 2026-04-05.
Sasha R: @Matt B fine with that. Eng-infra: @Javier T can you confirm riser for canary window?
Javier T: Confirmed, can do canary on 2026-04-02 — but need load test signoff from eng-sre first. blocker: we don't have the long-run perf test script updated.
Liz P: I'll own updating the perf test harness. ETA 2026-03-30. putting it on my calendar.
Matt B: thanks @Liz P — once that's in, I can schedule canary. updating doc now.
Anya K: To be explicit, here's the action table we want to lock. please paste any changes inline.
```
1) Update perf test harness — owner: Liz P — due: 2026-03-30
2) Autoscaler rollout config change — owner: Matt B — due: 2026-04-05
3) Canary execution and monitoring run — owner: Eng-infra (Javier T) — due: 2026-04-02
4) Post-rollout smoke + cost regression check — owner: SRE (Sasha R) — due: 2026-04-06
5) RCA doc final edits + closure note — owner: Anya K — due: 2026-04-07
```
Sasha R: small ask — add monitoring alert tweak as subtask under #4. I'll add it and set due 2026-04-06.
Javier T: noted. also request: can we get priority access to the GPU m1 pool on 2026-04-01 for load tests? Eng-infra needs approval.
Matt B: I can escalate to infra-allocs. putting a ticket now.
deploy-bot: ticket #INFR-482 created by Matt B for GPU pool allocation (link: https://redwood.team/t/INFR-482).
Liz P: one heads-up — updating the harness might change latency baselines. I'll flag regressions in the doc.
Anya K: ok — basically we need: owners confirmed here, and any blockers noted. If no objections, i'll mark the doc as 'locked' tomorrow EOD and PM will start coordination.
Sasha R: confirmed for SRE pieces.
Javier T: confirmed for infra pieces once ticket INFR-482 is approved.
Matt B: confirmed for autoscaler.
Liz P: confirmed for harness.
Anya K: thanks all. i'll update RCA doc and ping again if anything slips. :thumbsup:
